item.title: Trump’s TSP-for-All Proposal: What It Means for Workers—and Federal Employees
item.description: President Trump proposed a TSP-style retirement plan for workers without a 401(k). Here’s how it compares to the TSP and what it means for TSP investors.

item.title: Standard Deduction or Itemize? What Federal Employees Should Know for 2025
item.description: Federal employees: Don’t assume last year’s tax approach works in 2025—higher SALT caps mean itemizing could finally beat the standard deduction.

item.title: FEGLI Option C Refund for Life Insurance with No Eligible Family Member
item.description: Federal employees may get a refund of FEGLI Option C premiums if no eligible family members were covered while premiums were deducted.

item.title: What Parts of a Federal Employee’s Retirement Income Are Taxed?
item.description: Federal employees will find that most of their retirement income is subject to taxes. Planning ahead helps reduce tax surprises in retirement.

item.title: Appeals Court Upholds Trump Executive Order Restricting Collective Bargaining
item.description: Federal employee unions sued to stop an executive order excluding them on security grounds; brief wins faded as appeals stalled collective bargaining.

item.title: Why the TSP’s I Fund Is Outperforming—and How Long the Advantage May Last
item.description: The TSP’s I Fund is still outperforming U.S. stock funds. The trend has momentum, but it is not guaranteed to last. Here's what is driving the I Fund's performance.

item.title: When the “IRS” Calls, It May Be AI
item.description: AI-driven government impersonation scams are targeting federal retirees.

item.title: Physician, Heal Thyself
item.description: The author argues OPM criticizes union time costs but ignores its own far more expensive inefficiencies, echoing “Physician, heal thyself.”

item.title: FEGLI Explained: How to Avoid Overspending on Federal Life Insurance
item.description: FEGLI life insurance can become costly as you age, especially Option B. Audit your coverage, assess your needs, and consider alternatives to save money.

item.title: What Federal Employees Need to Know About the New ‘Schedule/Policy Career’ Rule
item.description: OPM's new Schedule Policy/Career rule reclassifies up to 50,000 federal jobs as at-will, stripping appeal rights. What will this mean for federal employees?
